identification: Group of 4 framed oil paintings of landscapes, probably early/mid 20th century decorative works: a snow-capped mountain and valley scene (NZ Fiordland/Southern Alps style) in black and linen slip frame; a pastoral river scene with a large tree in a gilt frame (largest, H49 x W69 cm, looks like oil or pastel on board); and a matching pair of tall narrow river-and-bush scenes in gilt frames. No legible artist signature (a tiny signature at bottom right of the tall panel is illegible on zoom).

viewing_check: Estimate $50-70, current bid $20. Decorative unsigned landscapes sell around $25-90 each online; a lot of 4 at $20 is reasonable for decor. Check in person for a legible signature on the tall panels and the large pastoral piece (oil vs pastel, any tears or foxing, back labels). The snowy mountain piece is the most appealing. Prices have been flat across 2023-2026. Bulky to ship.
